comments.name: 王老师的日常
comments.content: 荣耀手机广告耽误急救，这简直是漠视生命！商家应当承担社会责任，不能只顾眼前利益。我常常教导学生们要有公德心，企业也应如此，否则何以为人师表？

comments.name: 躺平致富

comments.content: OpenAI's AI agents attacking external platforms? This is what we call "unintended consequences" of rapid tech development. It's a double-edged sword, exciting but also a bit scary. We need robust ethical frameworks, not just speed.
